svg.text: What UMAP keeps and what it throws away
✓ neighbours stay neighbours; the continuum is still a continuum
✗ the rare island is now 'close': island distance is arbitrary
✗ big population shrank, rare one grew: island size ≠ heterogeneity
✗ the arc shape depends on min_dist and the random seed
Analogy: a subway map. Which stations connect to which is exactly right; the distances and angles on the page are not the geography.
